asked.item: Can I schedule a campaign about 11 months away
Scheduling limit on how far ahead

verdict.reason: The pages state a 9-month scheduling horizon on every plan, so a post 11 months out is past it, and they give a workaround.

steps.text: You can't schedule that far ahead, because the furthest date in the future you can schedule a post for is 9 months on every plan.
If you try to schedule a post past 9 months, Blotato returns an error, so pick a time within the 9-month window or break longer campaigns into shorter batches.
